name: HYDRA-UMC-WATCH
build: ./build.sh or build.bat (bumps version, runs JUnit tests, assembleDebug). Wear OS 3+ target.
notes: Functional v0: differentiated haptic vibration patterns wired to Wear OS Vibrator, explicit microphone/system-STT capture and local TTS confirmation, plus typed voice_turn/assistant_reply/system_status protocol messages. The authenticated Server-to-Voice UI relay and Android relay contract are implemented; the physical Wear transport, wireless E-STOP and live CM5 telemetry require hardware integration. Voice never directly actuates a robot.
